Inherited from Old Czech dievka, děvka, from Proto-Slavic *děvъka. By surface analysis, děva + -ka. Doublet of dívka.
Compare typologically Czech nevěstka (< nevěsta + -ka, whence also nevěstinec, a natively formed term for “brothel”).

examples.english: He couldn't get in until his friend, who got in through the secret entrance, opened from inside.
examples.text: Nemohl se dostat dovnitř, dokud mu zevnitř neotevřel přítel, který se dovnitř dostal tajným vchodem.
examples.translation: He couldn't get in until his friend, who got in through the secret entrance, opened from inside.

examples.english: That helped her get out of this place.
examples.text: To pomohlo jí dostat se z toho místa.
examples.translation: That helped her get out of this place.

examples.english: I think I finally broke through to my creative unconscious.
examples.text: Myslím že jsem se konečně dostala do mého kreativního podvědomí.
examples.translation: I think I finally broke through to my creative unconscious.

examples.english: He was a young man when he rose to power.
examples.text: Byl mladý když se dostal k moci.
examples.translation: He was a young man when he rose to power.
